description: The body of POST /v1/public-check, sent as exactly application/json: one printed document number and the check code printed beside it. The contract is experimental. A body that fails this schema is refused before the Source is read and writes no audit record.

checkCode.description: The printed check code, 24 RFC 4648 base32 characters. ASCII letters are uppercased before comparison and nothing is stripped, so a value with spaces, hyphens, or padding is refused.

documentNumber.description: The printed document number. The selector profile of the activated subject bounds it further; a value outside that profile is refused as an invalid selector before the Source is read.

title: Evidence public check request Version 1 alpha 1
